price_field_note: Document type: Monsma distributor STOCK PAGES (Monsma is the distributor that sells Jotul to Benson Stone). Each page shows a 'List Price' column only -- this is the Jotul retail/MSRP list price, not a separate dealer/wholesale price. Therefore msrp is populated and dealer_price is left null. Prices marked 'FOB Warehouse 01/26' and 'subject to change without notice'. Items flagged with an asterisk are non-stock products; items flagged 'uCannot Ship UPS or FedEx' (LTL freight only) are noted per accessory but no models are flagged as discontinued in this stock book. One model row is created per finish/manufacturer-code variant since each finish carries a distinct list price.
